summary: Custom N×N travel-cost matrix over the location array; used only when travel_cost=customized.
range: Array of integer arrays, N×N where N = len(locations.location). Effective only with options.objective.travel_cost=customized.

Each element in cost_matrix must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: options.objective.travel_cost. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Cost/distance/duration matrices must have consistent dimensions and indices.
